title: Epic RPG: Flask Bound
description: Adds RPG-style healing vials with charges and cooldowns.
body:
***

🧪 Flaskbound – RPG Healing Flasks

Flaskbound is a Minecraft 1.20.1 mod that adds an RPG-style healing system based on unlockable flasks.

✨ Features

  • Unlockable flasks with a dedicated use system.
  • Apothecary rank system to access more advanced flasks.
  • The player starts with 2 free flasks.
  • Additional flasks are unlocked using minerals added by the mod.
  • These minerals generate in the overworld at different depth layers.
  • Each flask tier requires a certain amount of materials to unlock.
  • Healing focused on flasks and potions.
  • Each flask has its own cooldown, capacity, strengths, weaknesses, and possible extra effects.
  • Improved HUD and tooltips to clearly display charges, cooldowns, and recharge progress.

🎮 Default Keybinds

  • Open Flask Menu: I
  • Use Flask: C

📌 Future Plans

Flaskbound is currently focused on Minecraft 1.20.1.

A Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge port may happen in the future if the mod receives enough support.
